title: Avro Lancaster PB171
memorial_details: description: This record comprises all information held by IWM’s War Memorials Register for this memorial. Where we hold a names list for the memorial, this information will be displayed on the memorial record. Please check back as we are adding more names to the database.
inscription: Remembering mu beloved brother / F/O Navigator Jerzy J. Bergman / 15.11.1922 - 19.7.1944 / and the crew of Lancaster PB171 BH-K / Forever in my thoughts and missed by / the family he never knew.
original_title: Flying Officer J J Bregman and crew of Avro Lancaster PB171
crash_date_review: Auto-corrected to 19.7.1944 but reverted — text date, not ISO
community_connection: The inscription mentions 'the family he never knew', indicating a local connection and impact.
